# Rockchip MPP public headers

Unmodified public headers from [rockchip-linux/mpp](https://github.com/rockchip-linux/mpp),
commit `20959ec3dabb313b8c33ca0b7b09c06ffd2a9caa` (2026-10-16).
See the copyright and license notices in each header and the accompanying
`Apache-2.0` and `MIT` license texts.

Only headers are included. The test links to the target box's existing
`libmpp.so`; it does not build or install a replacement decoder library.
